tess_sales: Heads-up: we've updated the public rate card to v6 draft for internal review. Major changes: clarified commit tiers, new migration-credit table, and APAC SKU exceptions (limited to dedicated/private deploys). Don't quote until we confirm final.
omar_dealdesk: link pls and any changes to the Deal Desk template?
tess_sales: https://redwood.internal/pricing/draft-ratecard-v6 6 change log is top-right. Deal Desk template needs a couple fields added for APAC exceptions.
sarah_revops: Which additional fields? I can update the template quickly.
omar_dealdesk: Add: "data residency attestation attached?", "SOC2 on file?", and "requested sku override mapping". Also a checkbox for onboarding-fee waiver if applied.
nate_se: ANZ reported confusion: will APAC exceptions remove the onboarding fee automatically? Customers expect a waiver when moving from CompetitorZ.
omar_dealdesk: No auto-waive. Onboarding fee waiver is an exception. Small waivers (< $5k) can be approved in Deal Desk form; larger need commercial sign-off and finance note in the contract.
priya_security: Security note: APAC exceptions for private deployments require completed data residency checklist and recent SOC2. If either's missing, we deny. Also require architecture diagram for network flow.
jason_finance: Migration-credit guidance: finance suggests cap = min(6 months, 0.25 * contract ARR) as a default. I'll publish a sample amortization CSV for quoting by EOD.
tess_sales: Ops: SKU names changed in the draft. Quoting tool will reject old names. Please use the SKU API to map old->new. Example mapping in changelog.
sarah_revops: I'll add a /sku command to slackbot that pulls sku-map and prints the mapping. Proposed snippet: `curl -fsS $PRICING_URL/api/sku-map | jq -r '.[] | "\(.old) -> \(.new)"'`
ratecard-bot: draft-ratecard v6 published by tess_sales at 1770011100. Changelog: /pricing/draft-ratecard-v6/changelog.
tess_sales: Action items: @omar_dealdesk update Deal Desk template, @sarah_revops add /sku lookup, @jason_finance post amortization CSV, @priya_security attach data residency checklist link. We'll lock the doc Friday 10:00 PT."
